title: Technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda (60–90 min)
text:
Technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda (60–90 min)

['From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@nimbus.ai>, Sophie Miller <sophie@nimbus.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 16:23:00 -0800
Subject: Technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda (60–90 min)

Hi Alex / Sophie,

Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today — great signal on the latency and cost constraints for your real-time assistant workload. Per our call, the best next step is a technical deep dive with our ML + infra leads so we can walk through:

- workload characteristics (prompt/sequence distribution, batch vs streaming),
- model variants (quantization options, NVMe/KV cache tradeoffs),
- deployment topology (hosted vs dedicated vs private), and
- SLOs / fallback policies and cost estimates based on your traffic shape.

Suggested format: 60–90 minutes with a short 10–15 minute context recap, 30–45 minute technical walkthrough, then 15–30 minutes for Q&A + next steps.

Can you confirm the right attendees from your side (ML/infra + engineering PM)? You mentioned bringing an ML lead — if possible please add Samir Patel (ML Lead). Below are a couple of 90-min slots in PST next week; if none work, paste some times and we’ll match calendars:

- Wed 18 Feb, 10:00–11:30 PST
- Thu 19 Feb, 13:00–14:30 PST
- Fri 20 Feb, 09:00–10:30 PST

I’ve attached a short proposed agenda and a mutual action plan that outlines pre-reads and success criteria. If you want any changes to the agenda, let me know and we’ll incorporate them ahead of the call.

Attachments: redwood-technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf; mutual-action-plan-nimbus.xlsx

Quick ask for your schedulers: please include timezone for each attendee and confirm Samir’s email so we can add him.

Best,

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123
https://redwood.com

', 'From: Alex Greene <alex.greene@nimbus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Miller <sophie@nimbus.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda (60–90 min)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the clear agenda. We’re definitely interested in digging into the quantization and caching topics.

Sophie (our ops lead) will coordinate the calendar. Proposed attendees: Samir Patel (samir.patel@nimbus.ai, ML Lead), Sophie Miller (Engineering Ops), Daniel Cho (Infra Engineer — will join if available). All US Pacific.

The Wed 18 Feb 10:00–11:30 PST slot looks good for us. If you can tentatively block that, Sophie will send the invite with final attendee list.

A couple of prep asks from our side:
- Can you include a short note on expected GPU footprint for a 95th percentile latency SLO for a 1k qps burst?
- Any example trace or perf numbers for prefix-caching with streaming workloads would be great to see in the session.

Thanks — we’ll get Samir looped in.

Alex
Head of Product
Nimbus AI
alex.greene@nimbus.ai

> Hi Alex / Sophie,
> 
> Thanks again for the productive discovery earlier today — great signal on the latency and cost constraints for your real-time assistant workload.
', 'From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nimbus AI deep dive — tentative time and prep

Neha / Vivek — looping you both in. Alex from Nimbus confirmed interest in the Wed 18 Feb 10:00–11:30 PST slot (90 min). Attendees expected from their side: Samir Patel (ML Lead), Sophie Miller (Ops), and possibly one infra engineer.

Main asks from Nimbus ahead of the call:
- expected GPU footprint for a 95th percentile latency SLO at 1k qps burst
- example traces/perf numbers for prefix-caching with streaming workloads

Suggested internal agenda (we’ll share a cleaned agenda with Nimbus):
1) 10–15 min: context + goals (Marissa)
2) 30–40 min: model/inference architecture deep dive (Vivek + Neha)
3) 20–30 min: deployment patterns and cost/runbook tradeoffs (Vivek)
4) 10–15 min: Q&A and next steps + mutual action items (Marissa)

Prep items:
- Neha: can you bring any slides/examples on prefix caching and batch/stream tradeoffs?
- Vivek: please sketch rough GPU sizing table (gives a range for 95th percentile at 1k qps) — can be back-of-envelope.

I’ll send a calendar hold once Sophie confirms final attendee emails.

Thanks — Marissa

', 'From: Sophie Miller <sophie@nimbus.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Alex Greene <alex.greene@nimbus.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@nimbus.ai>, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimbus.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Technical deep dive — scheduling and agenda (60–90 min)

Hi Marissa — confirmed. I’ve sent a calendar invite for Wed, 18 Feb 2026 10:00–11:30 PST (90 min) and added Samir + Daniel. Calendar link below.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=Nimbus-DeepDive-20260218

One quick agenda tweak — Samir would like 10–15 minutes dedicated to quantization accuracy tradeoffs (int8 vs int4) and any runbook notes about model fallback for degraded quantized variants. If we can slot that into the model/inference architecture section that would be ideal.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Sophie
Engineering Ops | Nimbus AI
sophie@nimbus.ai
